description: Two voltage-controlled amplifiers in 6HP, each with a level slider and a CV input

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, silent at the bottom of its travel and unity at the top
Chooses whether the CV input scales that channel in a straight line or exponentially

inputs.text: Scales that channel's level, 0V to 10V; with nothing patched the slider alone sets it

outputs.text: The amplified signal for that channel
